powerPointExport.editableContent: Main slide text and the repository hyperlink are native PowerPoint objects. Product screenshots and portraits are embedded images. Decorative HTML cards and connectors are preserved as transparent visual layers.
powerPointExport.nativeTemplateUsage: Reference slide 1 for the cover; reference slide 27 for section dividers, Demo and the closing slide; reference slide 3 for content panels; reference slide 6 for screenshot backgrounds; reference slide 26 for the getting-started content background. Unused slide and layout placeholders are removed to prevent default text areas overlapping editable titles in PowerPoint.

layoutAdaptation.treatment: Full-bleed blue-purple-cyan gradient, cyan left-aligned title and geometric forward motif.
Translucent rounded panel, bold headings, white cards, blue subheadings and purple/teal emphasis.
Screenshot-first layout: full-height image on the right; title, talking points and takeaway in a compact left panel. No top heading band or slide footer. White image frame and full-bleed gradient.
Order Processing architecture image in a near-full-height white frame, compact white title and FY27 gradient. Full image retained without cropping.

Contoso Order Intake team: four white cards with circular photo avatars, soft teal borders, names and prominent 32px semibold dark role labels on the FY27 panel background. Aadi: Global Order Reviewer; Alan: Global Order Approver; Carlos: Backoffice Customer Support; Davide: Contoso Retail Store Manager.
Section dividers with full-bleed blue-purple-cyan gradient, large white left-aligned titles and ascending triangular shapes on the right. The Demo divider and team slide precede Getting Started.
Light gray canvas, white cards and saturated lower gradient band.

Two-column guide: four steps for building a new process alongside a proposed Agent Forge Analyst Agent to Product Owner Agent to GitHub Copilot handoff. Prominent WORK IN PROGRESS badge distinguishes the proposed accelerator from the existing reference pattern.
Thank you closing slide, appended with explicit approval for the PowerPoint export.

adaptationNotes: HTML design treatments are recreated in CSS. The approved PowerPoint export reuses the user-provided FY27 deck's native layouts and artwork; no font files are included.
Gradient colors, geometry and panel opacity are visually approximated rather than pixel-identical to the source artwork.

Reference ROI figures and product claims are not copied. The approved total is 23 slides: 18 content slides, four section dividers and a closing slide, including the Order Processing architecture image at slide 12, the Demo divider at slide 17, the team portraits at slide 18 and the new-process development guide at slide 22. Agent Forge acceleration is a proposed work-in-progress approach, not a verified delivery pipeline or measured speed claim. Slides 7-10 use the four supplied UI screenshots; no screenshot placeholders remain. Review audience authorization or redact sensitive information before external distribution.

FY27 is the selected presentation style. The builder generates all pages directly from slides.mjs in this folder, with local base.css, styles.css and viewer.js. The alternate preview has been removed.

PowerPoint generation approved. The original FY27 cover and closing layouts are reused; section dividers adapt the closing layout. Content slides use the original FY27 backgrounds. The official repository hyperlink remains a clearly labeled placeholder.
